This presentation is live-coding an agentic map application using [agent-evaluated examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/24606.24282) and [the [agent-based evaluation framework](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/blob/main/agent-eval-framework-and-examples-script/agent-eval-summary.md)).

## The prompt that works

The prompt that works for this task uses an [agent-evaluated example](https://arxiv.org/abs/24606.24282) and an [agent-based evaluation framework](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/blob/main/agent-eval-summary.md).

The system prompt should use [agentic [instructions](https://developers.google.com/maps/ai/agent-skills-fieldwork/)](https://developers.google.com/maps/ai/agent-skills-fieldwork/) that make the agent an author that makes a decision. The evaluation checks whether that decision resulted in a better outcome, even when the grader is not looking at the map.

The agent should write the code, test the code, and verify the result. The grader then has to inspect the generated map and decide whether that result is follows the instructions and constraints.

## The code that makes it work

The [agent-eval-framework](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/blob/main/agent-eval-summary.md) packages [agentic [instructions](https://developers.google.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/blob/main/agent-skills-fieldwork/)](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-skills-fieldwork/) so they can be used across different models and environments. A [test-based [evaluation](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-eval-summary.md)) compares a [generated map](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/blob/main/agent-eval-framework-analysis/agent-eval-analysis.md) with a [baseline] and a [grading rule](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-eval-summary.md)) and returns a boolean for success. A [verification step](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-eval-summary.md)) runs the generated code and checks the generated map, then the grader inspects the generated map, decides if that result follows the instructions, and returns a boolean.

The code that makes it work is a [test suite](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-eval-summary.md) that runs the [agent](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-eval-agent-skills-fieldwork/agent-eval-agent-skills-fieldwork-v1.md)). The grader makes an [evidence-based decision](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/fieldwork/agent-eval-summary.md)) and then an [inspection check](https://github.com/ryanbaumann/field_evaluation/agent-fieldwork-agent-eval-summary.md)) returns a boolean. The grader then makes a decision based on the evidence, then an inspection check returns a boolean.
